details: Circle Internet Group received authorization from the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency to establish Circle National Trust, its own national trust bank. This breakthrough allows Circle to directly hold its multi-billion dollar USDC stablecoin reserves under federal banking oversight, reducing reliance on third-party financial institutions and boosting institutional adoption.
title: Circle Gets Federal Trust Bank Charter for USDC Reserves

details: Bitcoin's price has rebounded above $64,000, recovering from recent lows. This resurgence is attributed to increased holdings by institutional investors, signaling renewed confidence in the asset. Favorable regulatory developments in major markets are also contributing to a more welcoming environment for Bitcoin adoption.
title: Bitcoin Rebounds Past $64K as Institutions Boost Holdings

details: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization has reached $2.28 trillion, showing a 1.2% surge in the last 24 hours. Bitcoin's price gained 1.39% to reach $64,163.74, while Ethereum increased by 2.68% to $1794.03. Polkadot and XRP Ledger Ecosystem cryptocurrencies were noted among the top gainers.
title: Crypto Market Cap Exceeds $2.28 Trillion Amid Recovery

details: Arbitrum (ARB) experienced a significant rally, surging 13.5% after Robinhood launched its new Layer 2 chain, which utilizes Arbitrum's technology. This development was accompanied by $568 million in trading volume and the introduction of a new fee-sharing model.
title: Arbitrum Jumps 13.5% Following Robinhood Layer 2 Chain Launch

details: Bitcoin (BTC) price rose above $63,000, extending its recovery as geopolitical tensions between the US and Iran reportedly eased following earlier missile strikes. The overall risk-off sentiment in the crypto market appears to be diminishing, with the Fear and Greed Index showing an increase.
title: Bitcoin Price Up Over $63K Amid Easing US-Iran Tensions
